title: Argentinian Cheese Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Argentina, featuring oozing cheese as a key ingredient.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add diced tomato and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add Argentinian stew, red wine (if using), and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in shredded oozing cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
